events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Alexis Lafreniere scored the go-ahead goal on a deflection in the third period, and the New York Rangers beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 6-2 on Thursday night to pick up their first regulation win at home in more than three months.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rangers beat the Leafs 6-2 for their first home regulation win since Nov. 24

headlines.description: — Vitek Vanecek stopped 16 shots in his 100th career win and Dylan Guenther assisted on two Utah goals as the Mammoth beat the Philadelphia Flyers 3-0 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vanecek earns 1st shutout of the season, 100th career win in Utah's 3-0 victory over the Flyers

headlines.description: — Ryan McLeod and Alex Tuch scored short-handed goals and the Buffalo Sabres beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 5-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McLeod and Tuch score short-handed goals to power Sabres past Penguins, 5-1

events.name: Florida Panthers at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Jet Greaves made 26 saves, Mathieu Olivier scored twice and the Columbus Blue Jackets dealt another blow to Florida's playoff hopes with a 4-2 victory over the Panthers on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blue Jackets beat Panthers 4-2 in latest blow to 2-time defending champ's playoff hopes

headlines.description: — Matthew Wood scored twice to lead the Nashville Predators to a 6-3 victory over the Boston Bruins on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Forsberg's 3-point game, Wood's 2 goals lead Predators past Bruins 6-3

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Winnipeg Jets

headlines.description: — Connor Hellebuyck made 26 saves, Mark Scheifele had a goal and an assist and the Winnipeg Jets beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 4-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor Hellebuyck makes 26 saves in the Jets' 4-1 win over the Lightning

headlines.description: — Dylan Cozens scored a power-play goal 6:33 into the third period to snap a tie and lift the Ottawa Senators to a 4-1 win over the Calgary Flames on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dylan Cozens scores a power-play goal to lift the Senators past the Flames 4-1

events.name: New York Islanders at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Artemi Panarin scored his first goal in a Kings uniform, and Los Angeles beat the New York Islanders 5-3 on Thursday night for the club's first victory under interim head coach D.J. Smith.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panarin leads LA Kings past Islanders 5-3 for their 1st victory under interim coach D.J. Smith
